symptoms: Protected main was not Netlify production; canonical same-lineage fallback reached Netlify but build failed with provider exit code 2. Existing deploy read API did not include the individual failing phase.

root_cause_split.proven: Netlify exact main release eedc3f8... not LIVE; provider deploy 6ae79adf... state=error build exit 2. Current main tree had no successful Required prebuilt artifact and fallback had to perform full build. tools/ci/netlify-build-entry.mjs was covered by generic tools/ci/ governance exclusion in deriveNetlifyDeploymentApplicability; editing this executable build engine could skip mandatory full pre-merge build parity.
root_cause_split.unproven: Exact Netlify build phase that produced exit code 2 cannot be reconstructed from provider metadata; do not classify as i18n, npm, secrets, compilation, resource, or auth without phase log.

evidence.provider_error: Failed during stage 'building site': Build script returned non-zero exit code: 2

remediation: Classify the canonical build entry path as Netlify-runtime despite tools/ci governance prefix and force full production parity on that path. Emit phase-specific, secret-free NETLIFY_BUILD_PHASE_FAILURE with exit code, phase and optional profile on any canonical transform failure. Let original Required workflow reproduce phase and enforce a built artifact; do not alter I18N safety flags, release issuer, sender, parallel work or Netlify authorization.
prevention_rule: Any change to executable Netlify build entry must be gated by actual exact production build parity. Failure must record specific phase, canonical run SHA, provider ID and no secret data. A failed deploy never becomes LIVE by source merge, preview or a fresh retry.
